title: The call, in eight moves
purpose: The lead advisor's ten-slide training deck on taking a call.
facts: Slides: title; two minutes; the eight; hello; find out; the price is not the end; two times; when they doubt the price; three sentences I never say; listen.
Slide 9: "No problem." "It should be ready." "It is all warrantied.", each with her reason.
Slide 6 uses the brake inspection price 49.95.
Agrees with how-to/taking-a-call.md and how-to/price-objections.md; says nothing they contradict.
